title.original: Open Challenges in Multi-Agent Security: Towards Secure Systems of Interacting AI Agents
title.zh: 多智能体安全的开放问题：迈向安全的交互式 AI 智能体系统
title.en: Open Challenges in Multi-Agent Security: Towards Secure Systems of Interacting AI Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: 其跨学科威胁分类和安全权衡框架为 Agent 网络的设计审查与系统级风险研究提供共同基础。
inclusion_reason.en: Its cross-disciplinary threat taxonomy and security trade-off framework provide a common foundation for design review and system-level study of agent networks.

abstract.zh: 该论文将多 Agent 安全界定为独立研究领域，系统梳理交互网络中出现或被放大的串谋、群体攻击和传播性风险。
abstract.en: This paper frames multi-agent security as a distinct field and systematizes collusion, swarm attacks, and propagating risks that emerge or amplify through agent interactions.

problem.zh: 传统网络安全和单模型安全难解释自由协议、网络效应、分散隐蔽性与跨 Agent 传播共同形成的系统性威胁。
problem.en: Traditional cybersecurity and single-model safety do not explain systemic threats created jointly by free-form protocols, network effects, distributed stealth, and cross-agent propagation.

approach.zh: 作者整合安全、多 Agent 学习、复杂系统、博弈和治理视角，建立威胁分类并分析分布式与去中心化场景的安全权衡。
approach.en: The authors synthesize security, multi-agent learning, complex systems, game theory, and governance into a threat taxonomy and security trade-off analysis.

system_design.zh: 产出是分层研究框架而非运行时：按交互媒介、传播机制、攻击协作和受害范围组织威胁，并映射到防御与治理议题。
system_design.en: The output is an analytical framework rather than a runtime, organizing threats by interaction medium, propagation, adversarial cooperation, and impact, then mapping defenses and governance.

key_results.zh: 论文揭示隐私泄露、越狱、投毒和虚假信息可经 Agent 网络快速扩散，并提出跨学科的统一研究议程。
key_results.en: The analysis shows how privacy breaches, jailbreaks, poisoning, and disinformation can spread through agent networks and sets a unified cross-disciplinary agenda.

limitations.zh: 这是立场与初步分类工作，没有可执行防御或定量验证；威胁边界会随协议、能力和部署激励快速变化。
limitations.en: This is a position and preliminary taxonomy paper with no implemented defense or quantitative validation, and its boundaries will evolve with protocols, capabilities, and incentives.

notes.zh: 实验矩阵与数值将在全文人工复核后补充；当前留空以避免从摘要推断。
notes.en: The experiment matrix and numbers await full-text manual review; fields remain empty to avoid inferring them from an abstract.
